description: Start widget and call overlay: read projects, people and calls; start and run a call; drag and hide; hand over to another window (windows_show); read whether another app uses the microphone (mic_activity_get); start, stop and watch the recording (recording_*); read the transcript (transcript_*); read the call's questions and topics, act on a question and retry the agent (call_state_get, questions_act, agent_retry). No project, people or settings changes.
